QUICK DRAW BONUS (5 minutes — do this if you have extra time in Module 1)
This demo is pure delight. The AI guesses drawings in real time which creates an immediate wow moment.
SAY: "Now let's see something that will make you question what 'learning' really means. This AI has never been to school. It has never held a pencil. But watch what happens when I try to draw something."
DEMO SEQUENCE: 1. Go to quickdraw.withgoogle.com and start a round (you control the keyboard) 2. Draw something simple — maybe a cat, a bicycle, an umbrella 3. Let the class see the AI's guesses update in real time 4. When it guesses correctly, pause: "How did it know? It's seen 50 million drawings. It recognised the PATTERN, not the specific lines."
STUDENT INTERACTION: Ask a volunteer from the front row to suggest what to draw next. The laughter and surprise when AI gets it right (or hilariously wrong) is worth its weight in gold.
TIME CHECK: If you're running late, this slide can be skipped. Move directly to Module 2.
